title: Text: DET Lloyd McClendon ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I gotta go on MLB to talk about Nick at 3 p.m., talking about how he's become one of the AL's elite hitters. He's always been good but what's he improved on since last year, especially against lefties
His commitment to use the whole field to hit and his expanded knowledge of the pitchers and what they’re trying to do to him
